target_fidelity.note: It is a positive active imperative with no modal.

naturalness.note: The context and instruction form a coherent, natural request.

pedagogical_suitability.note: It provides focused practice producing an imperative.

determinacy.note: The cue also naturally permits “Turn the light on,” which is not accepted.

non_target_language_simplicity.note: The vocabulary and context are common and transparent.

no_answer_leakage.note: The prompt gives a cue but does not display the completed target sentence.

no_extraneous_grammar.note: No unrelated advanced grammar is needed.
